tools.name: pick_numbers
tools.description: Random numbers for a lottery game, 1 to 10 sets. Either name a game: kr645 (Lotto 6/45 (South Korea)), powerball (Powerball (USA)), megamillions (Mega Millions (USA, matrix since 2025-04-08)), euromillions (EuroMillions), uk_lotto (Lotto (UK)), jp_loto6 (Loto 6 (Japan)), jp_loto7 (Loto 7 (Japan)); o

tools.name: get_draw
tools.description: The winning numbers of the latest draw, or of one past draw. kr645: give the draw number (회차). powerball, megamillions: give the draw date YYYY-MM-DD. Sources: dhlottery.co.kr (Korea), data.ny.gov (USA).

tools.name: check_ticket
tools.description: Compare your numbers with a draw (the latest unless you give one). kr645 gives the rank and the prize per winner from the official record; powerball and megamillions give the match (prize amounts depend on state and multiplier and are not given).

tools.name: prismtect_number
tools.description: A personal two-digit number from the Prismtect glass prism, for a user who asks for a lucky number, a number of their own or a number for today. Only a human touch can draw it, so this tool gives no number: it gives the link your user taps themselves. Pass the link on.
